name: Video
description: A field type for storing uploaded or embedded videos.

suggests.drupal/flysystem: Recommended for storing video files on remote/cloud file systems.

project_description:
🇺🇦 
 
 This module is maintained by Ukrainian developers.

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 Important note: 
 You should only consider this module if you need to upload and manage your own videos. If you want to embed videos from YouTube and other providers please consider using Drupal core media suite. 

 What is "Video" module 
 Video module allows you to upload video in any format, play video in any format , transcode video to H.246, Theora, VP8 (Web compatible formats) using Zencoder or FFMPEG automatically creates video thumbnails, copy and deliver videos from cloud file systems like Amazon S3.

 
Module providers a reliable API for converting videos and create thumbnails , embed video to node body using WYSIWYG module (D7 only) and many more.

 Tutorials and resources 
 
 README.md 
 Video tutorial 
 Drupal Groups: Video Group 
 
 Installation 
 Required modules 
 
 Content Construction Kit (Drupal 6 only) 
 Filefield (Drupal 6 only) 
 Chaos Tools Suite (Version 6.x-5 only) 
 Libraries API (Drupal 7 or older) 
 
 Optional modules 
 
 Flysystem File Storage (Drupal 8 only) 
 Video Presets (Drupal 7 only) 
 Filemime (Drupal 7 only) 
 Video.js (Drupal 7 and up) 
 SWFTools (Drupal 7 or older) 
 Amazon S3 (Drupal 7 only) 
 WYSIWYG (Drupal 7 only) 
 Rules (Drupal 7 or older) 
 JW Player 5 with HTML5 (Drupal 7 only) 
 JW Player Module (Drupal 7 and up) 
 FileField Sources (Drupal 7 or older) 
 Integration with Media Browser (sandbox project, Drupal 7) 
 Colorbox (with this patch [#1155628] or from 7.x-2.11+) (Drupal 7 only) 
 Manual upload of multiple sources (sandbox project, Drupal 7) 
 
 Developers (8.x only)
